project.planMd: Owner direction 2026-11-02 (owner-direction:ov3-complete-agentic-harness). OV3 writes its own scope and canonical features from specification:ov3-complete-agentic-harness (sha256:a344104861ea0cb7e9557cc9b359a9e9567f7f3e921477d0cd596de0a6413c09), the owner accepts them at declared decision points, and OV3 then plans and builds its own future state from them. Bootstrap: the Frontier planner projected the specification from estate rows and planned the first two flights (long-value binds; scope). Plan approval is pending the owner.
project.goal: OV3 becomes a complete agentic harness - including, and not limited to, elaborate planning, self-improvement, multi-agent consensus and extra control-plane pieces - with deterministic multi-step task execution and no fuzziness or bespokeness for one line of work. It writes its own canonical features and then builds its own future state from them.
project.benefit: The harness design becomes durable authority in the estate, written and accepted before it is built, so no undocumented stance can become the implemented design again.
project.agentUserStory: As the OV3 network, I need to write my own scope and canonical features as a complete agentic harness from the owner's recorded directions and my declared state, have the owner accept them at declared decision points, and then plan and build my own future state from them, so that my design is durable authority in the estate.
project.acceptanceCriteria: The scope and one canonical feature per accepted capability area are written by OV3 capabilities from the retained specification, retained by digest, delivered for review and accepted by the owner at declared decision points; every later build task names the accepted feature it implements; each built capability declares its accepted feature as canonical; no stance that contradicts the owner direction remains unsuperseded.
